programs.title: Europe From Above 4
programs.desc: The Old Continent seen from an extraordinary perspective.A bird's eye view will allow you to discover architectural treasures as well as natural gems.Europe will also be shown during different seasons.

programs.title: Hostile Planet
programs.desc: There are places with extremely difficult conditions.Living there requires a constant fight for survival, adapting to fierce frosts, heat, storms, snowstorms and heavy rainfall.Access to these areas is often difficult.The situation is worsened by climate change and rare weather events that have impacted many species.The extraordinary cinematography by Guillermo Navarro, who won an Oscar for "Pan's Labyrinth", will better show this intriguing world where danger lurks at every step.

programs.title: America's Wild Spaces
programs.desc: A story about the untamed forces of nature, danger and natural wonders that can be discovered in the wildest regions of America.Viewers, together with the creators of the series, will visit Everglades National Park, the Grand Canyon, Death Valley, Glacier National Park and Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park.Even though all these places seem to be well-known and explored, each of them hides its own secrets.A journey in the footsteps of wild America will go far beyond guidebooks.Areas will be explored where humans are still guests and must absolutely obey the rules of nature.
